title: Employment Record
description: The link between a person and an organization, as a record in its own right. Keeping it reified was the right call in the original model and is kept here: an employment has dates, a title, a manager and its own lifecycle, none of which fit on a plain `relations` edge. The same pattern serves frequency licenses, SOP approvals and org memberships. From the original: person / organization / manager / office_location -> relations, start_date and end_date -> envelope valid_from and valid_to, is_primary -> the relations entry's `primary` flag, is_current -> derived, never stored.

relations.description: Must contain exactly one rel='person' and one rel='organization' edge; everything else is optional.

employment_type.description: Null when the source system did not say.

work_email.description: Work contact lives here, not on the person, because it changes when the job does.

office.description: Free-text office name. The office as a real site goes in relations as rel='office_location'.

compensation.description: Almost always warrants visibility=confidential on the whole record.

$comment: is_current is derived, not stored: valid_to == null && status == 'active'. Storing it guarantees a record that says is_current: true with an end_date two years in the past.

examples.label: Cameron Dietz - CSSR @ Applied Industrial Technologies
